mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT thread_id FROM turns WHERE state IN ('QUEUED','RUNNING','WAITING_APPROVAL') UNION SELECT DISTINCT thread_id FROM tools WHERE side_effect='EXTERNAL' AND state IN ('PREPARED','RUNNING') ORDER BY thread_id
mapper.update: UPDATE turns SET state='CANCELLED',mutation_version=mutation_version+1,updated_at=#{occurredAt},completed_at=#{occurredAt}, terminal_summary=CASE WHEN cancel_requested_at IS NOT NULL THEN 'Cancelled before sidecar restart' ELSE 'Recovered after sidecar restart' END, error_code=CASE WHEN cancel_requested_at IS NOT NULL THEN 'CANCELLED' ELSE 'RUNTIME_RESTARTED' END, error_message=CASE WHEN cancel_requested_at IS NOT NULL THEN 'The Turn cancellation request was committed before the sidecar stopped.' ELSE 'The previous sidecar stopped before the Turn reached a terminal state.' END WHERE thread_id=#{threadId} AND state IN ('QUEUED','RUNNING','WAITING_APPROVAL')

UPDATE tools SET state='UNKNOWN', presentation_json=json_set(presentation_json,'$.status','error','$.outputPreview', 'Ja restarted around an external side effect; its outcome cannot be confirmed.'), revision=revision+1,updated_at=#{occurredAt} WHERE thread_id=#{threadId} AND side_effect='EXTERNAL' AND state IN ('PREPARED','RUNNING')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO turn_change_sets(thread_id,turn_id,workspace_id,change_set_json,artifact_id,committed_at) SELECT x.thread_id,x.turn_id,t.workspace_id, json_object('state','unavailable','reason','capture_failed','files',json_array(), 'stats',json_object('files',0,'additions',0,'deletions',0,'binaryFiles',0,'truncated',json('false'))), NULL,#{occurredAt} FROM turns x JOIN threads t ON t.thread_id=x.thread_id WHERE x.thread_id=#{threadId} AND x.completed_at=#{occurredAt} AND x.state='CANCELLED' AND x.error_code IN ('CANCELLED','RUNTIME_RESTARTED') AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM turn_change_sets c WHERE c.turn_id=x.turn_id)
